cases.claim: “STUCK AT HOME WITH ASTHMA. IT’S RUFF” (meme) | “Asthma. Does it have you missing out on what you love, with who you love? Get back to better breathing with FASENRA. . . .”
cases.context: Woman at home → park with friends, frisbee with dog, selfie with 'likes'. AQLQ(S)+12 total responder rate improved vs placebo, but studies not designed to measure individual items incl. social/emotional functioning.
cases.rationale: Implies improved social/emotional functioning; greater benefit than demonstrated.
cases.check: Judge: before/after social-life transformation (memes, 'likes', 'missing out') when only a total QoL score was studied; item-level social/emotional claims unsupported.
